about: T-596 THE WISH TO SING (DRAFT, every word and pixel): a daemon near its evolution hums a bar of its song as it knows it, quietly under ROUTE 1's music, each note a small note rising from its mouth in its pitch's colour (PLAY's colours; a black key split between the white keys either side), a note not yet learned as static that shows its colour only as its true pitch is heard; and after a battle won it asks, 'NAME wants to sing.', and YES sings its song with the notes rising. The lead made ROVERCUB and set 240/255 into its own part (DEBUG -> GAME EVENTS -> FOLLOWER -> LEAD NEAR ITS SONG, which also brings a hum a second later); the ask by ASK TO SING (AS IF A WIN), then by a wild battle won. The theatre's debug scratch save; nothing is saved. Watch held at day, clear weather.

stops.stop: standing on ROUTE 1, ROVERCUB near its song: it hums, the notes rise from its mouth
walking: the notes it hums are left behind in the air, drifting the way it faces
the ask, as if a battle were won: 'NAME wants to sing.', YES, and it sings with its notes rising
steps: events "FOLLOWER >" "ASK TO SING (AS IF A WIN)"

stops.stop: after a wild battle won: it may ask (the nearer, the likelier -- about five in six here)
